briefs.name: 01-passage
briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one exceptional classic logo for the brand spelled exactly "Reef", an independent institutional financial research desk. Concept: PASSAGE. A bespoke architectural capital R symbol, confident solid strokes, a beautifully judged negative-space channel cut through its bowl and diagonal leg, subtly suggesting a passage through a reef without illustrating waves. The silhouette should be instantly memorable and simple enough for a favicon. Pair the symbol to the left of the word Reef in a finely drawn, sturdy old-style Roman serif wordmark: moderate contrast, graceful bracketed serifs, open counters, impeccable optical kerning. This is a timeless, scholarly financial identity with subtle character, not a fashion label. Primary logo centered on a spacious warm cream #faf8f5 canvas, very large logo occupying approximately 65% of canvas width. All artwork uses a single dark forest ink #2d3a2e. Flat, crisp vector-like edges, careful geometric proportions, ample clear space. Only text is "Reef". One main horizontal symbol-plus-wordmark lockup, no concept captions or extra variants. Avoid stock R shapes, upward arrows, triangles, coins, charts, shields, gradients, bevels, textures, shadows, mockups, ornamental fine lines or copied existing logos. Premium professional brand identity, quiet and original.

briefs.name: 02-tide
briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one exceptional classic custom wordmark logo spelling exactly "Reef" for an institutional financial research desk. Concept: TIDE. Wordmark-led identity, no separate icon. Draw bespoke refined serif lettering with a graceful but strong capital R, a distinctive pair of open lowercase e counters, and a terminal f whose gently curved extended lower stroke folds back toward the baseline, suggesting a calm tidal current through the typography. The f flourish must be brief, disciplined and integrated into the lettering, not an underline, not a decorative wave. Form a subtle custom e-e rhythm or ligature while preserving immediate readability as Reef. Classic calligraphic foundations with balanced medium-weight stems and moderate stroke contrast; cultivated 20th-century editorial identity, legible and durable rather than wispy fashion typography. Impeccable optical spacing, exquisite proportions, genuinely custom lettering. Center the wordmark large on a spacious warm cream #faf8f5 canvas, logo occupying roughly 65% of canvas width. Single flat dark forest ink #2d3a2e, vector-like clean edges. Only text "Reef". One main logo only. No badges, no emblem, no arrows, no mountains, no reef illustration, no charts, no gradients, no textures, no mockups, no shadows, no additional labels or variants. It must feel timeless and distinctive, suitable for a research publication masthead and website navigation.

briefs.name: 03-reef-seal
briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design one exceptional classic logo for an institutional financial research brand named exactly "Reef". Concept: REEF SEAL. A compact round emblem with a clean circular boundary, containing two or three bold interlocking contour forms that create an abstract reef and a quiet negative-space channel. Evoke the discipline of a cartographic survey and the permanence of an archival seal, without literal water, palm trees, boats, compass stars, letters inside the circle, or ornamental rings. The inner structure should feel balanced, carved and unmistakable, formed by broad shapes that survive reduction to 24 pixels. Place this emblem to the left of the word "REEF" in an expertly spaced classic humanist sans-serif wordmark, slightly wide capital proportions, medium weight, warm not geometric-tech. Emblem height approximately 1.6 times cap height. This must feel like a long-established independent research institution, quiet, refined and original, not a crypto exchange or insurance company. One main horizontal emblem-and-wordmark lockup centered large on a spacious cream #faf8f5 canvas, occupying 65% of the width. One flat dark forest ink #2d3a2e; sharp clean vector-like edges. Only text "REEF". Avoid decorative detail, laurel wreaths, shield crests, upward charts, triangles, stock monograms, gradients, metallic finishes, shadows, textures, realistic mockups, supplementary captions and multiple versions.
